checks.name: revenue matches the kept orders
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.daily_revenue d full outer join (select cast(ordered_at as date) as order_date, count(*) as order_count, sum(amount) as revenue from raw.orders where status not in ('cancelled', 'returned') group by 1) e using (order_date) where d.revenue is distinct from e.revenue

checks.name: order_count matches the kept orders
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.daily_revenue d full outer join (select cast(ordered_at as date) as order_date, count(*) as order_count, sum(amount) as revenue from raw.orders where status not in ('cancelled', 'returned') group by 1) e using (order_date) where d.order_count is distinct from e.order_count
